blockers.name: Free-library management access
blockers.detail: The connected management account does not expose the website’s Free-library project. New schema, Storage policies, protected uploads and new server jobs cannot be activated through that connection.

blockers.name: Search Console and Bing
blockers.detail: Account authorization and real property data are required for API sync and URL Inspection. Manual Search Console Performance CSV analysis is available in this admin.

blockers.name: Content and distribution review
blockers.detail: Imported listings, native template distribution and translated pages need their own review. Discovery metadata and UI translations are not proof of verified resource terms or reviewed translated content.

blockers.name: Submission and email services
blockers.detail: Live moderation, opt-in email, unsubscribe/deletion and scheduled operational services need a configured backend and delivery provider. No fake successful delivery is shown.
